4. INSTALL NO.2 FUEL PIPE
(a) Install the No.2 fuel pipe and clamp bolt.
(b) Install the union bolt and new two gaskets to the pressure regulator. Torque the union bolt.
Torque: 250 kg-cm (18 ft-lb, 25 N-m)
(c) Connect the fuel hose.

F11720

5. INSTALL NO.1 FUEL PIPE
(a) Install the No.1 fuel pipe with VSV with the clamp bolt.
(b) Connect the pipe to the fuel pipe support with the union bolt and new gaskets. Torque the union bolts.
Torque: 300 kg-cm (22 ft-lb, 29 N-m)
(c) Connect the pipe to the delivery pipe with the union bolt (7M-GE) or pulsation damper (7M-GTE) and new gaskets. Torque the union bolt or pulsation damper.
Torque: 400 kg-cm (29 ft-lb, 39 N-m)
